name: OmniVoice
purpose: Massively multilingual zero-shot TTS with voice cloning and voice design (card).

license.name: CC-BY-NC (weights), Apache-2.0 (code)
license.notes: HF card (no LICENSE file in the repo): "Our code is released under the Apache 2.0 License. The pre-trained model is licensed under the CC-BY-NC due to constraints from its training data (e.g., Emilia)." The HF license tag is empty. Maintainer confirmed in discussion 37 (2026-09-14/18): weights non-commercial; Emilia has a CC BY-NC part, and the Higgs audio tokenizer dependency needs extra permission above 100k annual users. Code repo LICENSE (GitHub) is Apache-2.0. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: diffusion-language-model style, NON-AUTOREGRESSIVE generation, fine-tuned from Qwen3-0.6B-Base

weaknesses: German not named on the card

user_reports.summary: Maintainer: the model weights are non-commercial and cannot be used commercially; Emilia has a CC BY-NC part and another tokenizer dependency has its own terms.

tona_fit.reason: 600+ languages including German in 0.6B (RTF 0.025, vendor) fits every class; no quality numbers beyond speed are recorded, so compare German output against the other TTS records before any offer.

open_questions: German quality: no independent numbers; one community benchmark thread (discussion 30, 2026-07-02) exists but was not read
